wbs.description: Implement deterministic index inventory and conjunctive evidence classification
Implement lock-scoped journal preparation, atomic apply, and interrupted replay
Add inspect, apply, and verify CLI modes plus migration guard integration
Apply reconciliation to main authority and run focused and repository verification

risks: Loose stale-path matching could retire a real review
